title: Bay Fishing Charter
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
San Diego offers world class fishing, inshore and offshore, from the novice looking to catch their first fish to the trophy hunter looking to set a personal best record. Inshore fishing trips are shorter and focus on the bay and kelp beds targeting the various types of bass found in our local waters including halibut and bass. During the late summer months, there is even the chance for some pelagic fish like Yellowtail and Bonito. 

Fishing in San Diego Bay is a great, outdoor activity for the family, that will make lasting memories any time of the year. The boat provides a large, stable platform for fishing with plenty of extra room to relax , take in the views, or just watch while others try their luck fishing for the big one. The classic trawler has a comfortable enclosed cabin for protection from the elements, a full size bathroom, and room to relax or take a nap.
All the fishing gear is included. Drinks and snacks are provided. All charters can be customized upon request.
